title: Meta removes ToS language that suggested it could scrape websites "associated with" business accounts, saying it applied only to "ads and business products" (Terrence O'Brien/The Verge)
summary: Terrence O'Brien / The Verge: Meta removes ToS language that suggested it could scrape websites “associated with” business accounts, saying it applied only to “ads and business products” — Language that experts say allowed the scraping of news sites to train its AI has been remov
reason: Meta's removal of ToS scraping language is a company terms-of-service change, not a model release, research artifact, business event (financing/M&A/partnership/product launch), government policy action, or OSS tool release. No active rule covers it.
